# F3Nyx — Ember 🔥

Adios **Crovan**, bonjour **F3Nyx** (Phoenix): Release V rises with a calmer dark look, a one-tap **phone / panel** switch, a new smart-panel layout and big files that no longer crash.

## ✨ What's New

- 🔀 **Phone / panel switch** — A small switch with a phone icon and a panel icon sits in the centre of the top bar. Tap the other side to change layout; a short switch screen (Jarvis for phone, Friday for panel) confirms it.
- 🏫 **New panel layout** — QR and code on the left with round **Big QR**, **New code** and **Animation** buttons; progress and a **Received today** list (Files / Text) on the right.
- ⚡ **Back-to-back sending** — The panel keeps its code for 10 minutes and is ready again within seconds, and your phone remembers the panel, so you can send file after file without rescanning.
- 🔍 **Big QR** — One tap shows a full-screen QR with the code in large letters, readable from the back of a classroom.
- 📲 **Show QR / Scan QR** — Transmit and Retrieve both have round **Show QR** and **Scan QR** buttons. One phone shows the QR, the other scans it, and the transfer starts by itself. A small **i** explains both.
- ℹ️ **Quiet help** — On the panel, the how-to steps hide behind a round **i** button and open only when you tap it.
- 🗂️ **Two-card layout** — Everything you set up sits in one card; progress and the finish animation get their own card below, so nothing overlaps.
- 🫧 **Water-drop taps** — Files, Folder and Text are three small icons with a sliding bubble. Tapping them, the phone / panel switch or Transmit / Retrieve sends out a soft ripple.
- 🔢 **Big numbers** — After picking files, Transmit shows the count and total size in large, light type.
- ⭕ **Progress ring** — Transfers show a ring that fills up and turns red → yellow → green, with speed, amount sent and time left.
- 📦 **Big files fixed** — 10 GB and larger files now send without the app closing. F3Nyx also checks free space before saving.
- 🔔 **Notifications** — See percentage, speed and time left while a transfer runs, with Cancel. When files arrive, a "Retrieved" notification lets you Open or Share them.
- 📤 **Share all** — Share every received file at once, or jump to the Downloads folder.
- 🔘 **Round buttons** — Round glass buttons replace the old text buttons. Cancel, Done and Retry are round too.
- 🚀 **Finish animation** — The suit lifts off after sending, and after receiving he flies down and lands in a superhero pose. It plays inside its own card, is off by default on the panel, and is skipped when battery saver or Android's "remove animations" is on.
- 🎨 **Monet theme** — Appearance now offers System, Light, Dark and Monet. Monet takes accent colours from your wallpaper (Android 12+) while backgrounds stay neutral.
- ☀️ **Light mode polish** — The progress ring, logo, switch and buttons are clear on light backgrounds.
- 🔤 **New fonts** — Inter for text and JetBrains Mono for codes, so codes are easier to read out.
- 🌍 **Translations** — Everything new is translated into Español, हिन्दी, 简体中文 and 繁體中文.
- 🎨 **New name and icon** — Crovan becomes F3Nyx, with the red and gold arrows icon and an Android themed icon.

## 📥 Two Versions

1. **Standard** (about 16 MB) — works with both old and new croc. Pick this if unsure; recommended for smart panels.
2. **Lite** (about 12 MB) — newest croc only, smaller download.

Both look and work the same, and either installs over the other.

## ⚠️ Important — Before You Install

F3Nyx has a **new app ID**, so it installs next to Crovan instead of replacing it.

1. **Coming from Crovan:** install F3Nyx, then uninstall Crovan when you no longer need its history. History and settings do not carry over.
2. **On Android 13 and newer:** allow notifications when asked, to see transfer progress.

Received files are now saved in `Downloads/F3Nyx`. Needs Android 8 or newer on a 64-bit phone.

## 📦 Based On

F3Nyx (formerly Crovan and Kroc-Sauria) is a fork of [Croc](https://github.com/schollz/croc) by schollz.
The underlying Croc project and its original authors remain credited.
